title: 5.9 Ordering Politely
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Recognize a café and order a drink with please, and say Here you are. and Thank you.
grammar_function: This is a café. Coffee, please. Here you are. Thank you.
speaking_outcome: Order a drink with please, and say Here you are. and Thank you.
